notes.title: Online feature fixed
notes.content:
In this update and maintenance, we have fixed the functionality of the list server so that everyone can play games with their friends



We have also optimized the gaming experience, and the following are the main contents:



1. Fixed bug of getting stuck and flashing when running with prey



2. Increased Ai density and task refresh speed in the Diaz Plain



3. Enhanced stability for friends online



Welcome everyone to give feedback in this log

notes.title: Bug fixed V1.0
notes.content:
First, we must apologize for our lack of testing that leads to unpleasant experiences for players.

Right now, we are updating our first patch which brings following changes:

1. Remaining food: Now, there will be a piece of meat near you when you are respawned, allowing you to have some 'emergency supply' while you are still a cub.

2. In order to help players to find preys easier, we enlarged the detecting range of leopards. Press "V" to sniff, this feature will help you to track down preys in a wide range of 500m. Once been detected there will be a red arrow on the top of your preys to help you locate them.

3. Now, the players can see each others' name when they are in the same server. Players' names will be shown to let you know their direction while you are playing.

4. Only adult leopard are capable of climbing trees, fixed the bug of cubs able to climb trees.

So far, you can find following creatures on Divach Plain: crows, sparrows, robins, hares, beavers, lemmings, elks, poachers and the most dangerous groups of female lions. You can also find giraffes, hippos and elephants, but they are not interactable at current stage. But they will become world bosses in future updates.

There are also some creatures such as male lions and wildebeests that we were not able to add in to the game due to time reason. We will add them into the game in following updates. Other bugs like the edge of the map is under processing, will be fixed soon.

notes.title: 开发日志6
notes.content:
DevBlog#6
    Hi, everyone. This is Lightning Fast Devs, once again we apologize for our delay of the early access announcement. During this peroid of time, we improved and optimized Lightning Fast from various aspects.
        1. AI intellegence improved
               We optimized the sight and hearing of our AI. While you are in the cover of rocks, slopes or trees, your preys are unlikely to notice you by sights. Yet they are still sensitive to your noises. Use the sneaking mode wisely to travel from a cover to another to deliver the lethal bite to your preys.
        2. Birds AI available now
               In the trailer, we represented the scene of crows feed on the body. Now apart from crows, more birds settled down in Divach Plain. Use your advantage of speed to catch them off guard!
        3. Smaller preys
               Hares and other smaller preys are perfect for cubs. As we are adding these creatures to the game, grown leopard could also try hunt them when in extreme hunger.
    We also improved our costumization system and the balance of the game.
    We will further improve the game and share the progress with you in next DevBlog. If you have any idea or advice, please give us feedbacks on Steam, discord and twitter.

notes.title: DevBlog#5:
notes.content:
It has been a while, we mainly focused on the map optimization, interactive system, skill system and costumize system. Right now we are working around the clock to prepare for the lauch of the early access version, improvements were made on daily basis:
        1. Map optimization:
               We optimized the vegetation coverage in the Divach Plain (game map), embrace the nature and enjoy the views!
      {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/c8ee1aa437f82510a33252856f6d9db1c6582a21.png
        2. New interactive feature:
               It is inevitable to get wounded sometimes, especially on the cruel Divach Plain. Facing such life and death situation, now your parnters are able to heal you faster by licking your wounds. Or when you are still struggling to grow, your parnters now can share their growing points with you to speed up the process. All of these features are presented with thorough animation. Enjoy the moments of friendship.
     {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/5aa88087512133fc706f52dfecc4d1b967e22438.png 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/dc98f4412e068c77f7f882c11ec21d72114c5beb.png
  3. Skill system:
               In Lightning Fast, you can gain growing points by completing tasks or simply the passage of time. Distributing the points to 'attack', 'health', 'speed' and 'stamina' would define your way of survival. Be advised, the points for these four attributes are limited, even if you are fully grown, you are not able to upgrade all four attributes to max. However, the points itself continues to grow, the extra points can active special perks or you can also share the points with your partners.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/a3e88acedaf6fea7783cca253d9ee5f8064cce9c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/6b35ffbe2b3eec746b333dde17fd4eac641859fc.png
        4. Costumize system:
               Ever thought of having different eyes, ears of different sizes or even different colors? We have realized this feature and plan to optimize this feature in the future devlopment. You can now create the unique image of yourself through the various color combinations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/3ba550511e45851c77934e7c3b0af66ed2c43e9f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/58633a96fcbdcbec2449ff2433f87dc6d8adf1ff.png
    Apart from things mentioned above, we further improved the climbing system. Meanwhile, you can now get more violent and brutal with poachers to teach them a lesson.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/fb9616bcdfb24d2887b665992b5454210376010e.png
    We will further improve the game and share the progress with you in next DevBlog. If you have any idea or advice, please give us feedbacks on Steam, discord and twitter.

notes.title: DevBlog#4
notes.content:
Long time no see, we had been focusing on the mission system during the past three weeks. And have realized following features:
        1. Co-op missions:
               As a Co-op game, Lightning Fast considers co-op experiences as our priority. Therefore, we value the concept of 'co-op missions'. These tasks are of higher difficulty but are rather entertaining at the same time. How you complete the missions with your partners or to pick the mission that you're capable of would be a demonstration of your survival ability. Once complete these tasks, every player that participate in the mission will gain the reward. Face the challenges with your partners!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/6cc2e7e99d1bec066206d2536cc5844181377aab.png
        2. Single missions:
               Ever think of flying solo? We have created single missions for lone wolves, providing outstanding survival experiences for these players.
        3. Guidance missions:
               It is quite common to feel confused when playing a new game. So we have created a series of missions that introduce the entire game from the controls to the way of survival, allowing you to get familiar with the game in a short time. Thus you can get a quick start on Divach Plain.
        4. Other plans:
               Next, we will further optimize the hunting experiences. Also, the spcefic details of the missions will be revealed as the game will officially be put on sale at the end of this month. We promise you that Lightning Fast is definately a game worth-playing and will share the progress with you in next DevBlog.

    If you have any idea or advice, please give us feedbacks on Steam, discord and twitter.

notes.title: DevBlog#3
notes.content:
As a Co-op game, Lightning Fast values AI logic, for it has been proved vital for players' experiences. Last two week, we had been putting much effort in AI logics and realized following features:
        1. AI alert system:
               Now, the creatures of Divach Plain have alert ranges. As a predator, if you just wandering around undisguised, your prey will likely to be alerted and keep some distance. However, if you lower your body try sneaking upon your target, then perhaps you will win your meal.
        2. AI groups:
               In some games, AI works only on their own. Even social animals run randomly and not being 'social' which could make it unnatural when you chase down your preys. Well, we can confidently tell you that Lightning Fast have done an outstanding job in AI groups. When those gregarious AI form a group, they would react differently toward differnt level of threat and may even try their best to protect the weaks.
               Meanwhile, our optimized AI allow players to experience huge AI groups. Dozens of wildebeests running on the plain will no longer be a fantasy.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40013459/19024b99b5fb4e78ec9a16767986db16e3722ea9.png
        3. Human AI:
               Poachers now are able to use not only sniper rifles for long distance attack but also diggers and handguns for close range self defence. These terrifying enemies are definately the biggest challenge for leopards. Try to avoid them or crush them! The decision is up to you and your allies.
        4. Other plans:
               Next, we will move on to mission systems. We are planning to give players various optional missions and challenges. We believe this would make the game much more entertaining and will share the progress with you in next DevBlog.
